identity.title: Timeline of events in Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver

leadText: In , Ash Ketchum continues his quest to become a Pokémon Master by ing through the Johto region alongside and . Starting from New Bark Town, he aims to collect eight Johto League Gym Badges to qualify for the Johto League Conference. Along the way, Ash catches new Pokémon, encounters Legendary Pokémon like and , and faces both old and new rivals.
